verdict: Eaton's sales jumped 28% to a record $8.9 billion on booming demand for electrical equipment, though higher interest and acquisition costs held net income growth to 7%, at $1.08 billion.

segments.name: Electrical Americas
segments.note: Power equipment for data centers, utilities and buildings in the Americas — Eaton's biggest business.

segments.name: Electrical Global
segments.note: Electrical equipment outside the Americas, boosted by the Boyd Thermal acquisition.

segments.name: Aerospace
segments.note: Hydraulics, fuel and motion systems for aircraft, helped by the Ultra PCS acquisition.

segments.name: Mobility
segments.note: Transmissions and powertrain parts for trucks and cars — slated to be separated in a deal with Dana.

opex.name: Selling and administrative
opex.note: Sales teams and the back office.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $198M (up from $67M a year ago as debt rose to fund acquisitions) plus $20M of other expense, net — a $218M drag below operating profit.

takeaways.title: Record sales
takeaways.text: Sales hit a record $8.9 billion — 19% organic growth plus 8 points from acquisitions. Electrical Global rose 58% to $2.7 billion with Boyd Thermal in its second full quarter.

takeaways.title: Record segment margins
takeaways.text: Segment operating profit was $2.26 billion at a record 25.3% margin, and the combined Electrical backlog grew 46% year over year.

takeaways.title: Interest costs tripled
takeaways.text: Net income rose just 7% despite the sales surge because interest expense jumped to $198M from $67M and acquisition amortization weighed on GAAP profit; adjusted EPS was a record $3.68.

oneTimers: GAAP profit carries $314M of intangible amortization, mostly from acquisitions — the main reason GAAP EPS of $2.77 sits well below adjusted EPS of $3.68.
Eaton agreed in September to acquire COL Group for about $921M (expected to close in Q1 2027) and plans to separate its Mobility segment in a Reverse Morris Trust deal with Dana.
footerNote: Eaton reports in rounded millions and notes that columns may not add due to rounding; cost of products sold is shown $1M higher here ($5,843M vs the reported $5,842M) so the chart balances exactly. Net income is the consolidated $1,079M; $1,078M was attributable to Eaton shareholders.
